name: United Arab Emirates University
tuitionNote: AED 1,900-2,500 per credit hour depending on college (Engineering/IT/Health Sciences highest at AED 2,500/credit); estimated at ~AED 75,000/yr for a 30-credit/yr load in a high-fee college (uaeu.ac.ae, 2025-26). Master's rate assumed similar per-credit as exact graduate figure not published — verify before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: High school certificate (equivalent to UAE Grade 12) with required average, EmSAT or IELTS 5.5-6.0 depending on program, program-specific subject prerequisites
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree in relevant field with minimum GPA (typically 3.0/4.0), IELTS 6.0 or equivalent, some programs require GMAT/GRE

name: American University of Sharjah
tuitionNote: AED 53,823/semester (≈AED 107,646/yr) undergraduate for 12-16 credits, 2025-26 (aus.edu official fee guide); Master's estimated at AED 4,244/credit x 30 credits ≈ AED 127,320/yr (Arts & Sciences rate; varies by college). QS rank cited as both 364 and 272 in different 2025-26 sources -- verify before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: High school diploma, SAT/ACT scores recommended, IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 71 or equivalent, competitive GPA
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree with minimum 3.0/4.0 GPA, IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 79, GMAT/GRE for some programs

name: Khalifa University
tuitionNote: AED 2,500/credit hour cited by ku.ac.ae official page, ~AED 75,000/yr for a 30-credit load; however some third-party sources cite AED 3,333/credit (≈AED 100,000/yr) for undergraduate/preparatory -- figures conflict, verify before publishing. Master's assumed at same per-credit rate pending official graduate fee confirmation.
bachelorRequirements: High school certificate with strong STEM grades, EmSAT/SAT, IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 79, competitive admission given government-funded scholarships for Emirati priority
masterRequirements: Bachelor's in relevant STEM field with minimum 3.0/4.0 GPA, IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 79, GRE for some programs

name: Zayed University
tuitionNote: AED 2,500/credit hour for international undergraduate students (zu.ac.ae official page), ~AED 75,000/yr for a 30-credit load; some sources estimate total annual range of AED 84,000-130,000 depending on program. Master's rate assumed equal to bachelor's per-credit rate -- exact graduate schedule not confirmed, verify before publishing. Ranked 23rd in QS Arab Region Rankings 2026 but no confirmed global QS World Ranking found.
bachelorRequirements: High school certificate, EmSAT/IELTS 5.5-6.0, competitive GPA, has two campuses (Abu Dhabi and Dubai)
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree with minimum 3.0/4.0 GPA, IELTS 6.0, relevant work experience for some programs

name: American University in Dubai
tuitionNote: AED 51,515/semester (≈AED 103,030/yr) for 12-16 credits, plus AED 2,000/yr services & technology fee, 2025-26 (aud.edu official page). Master's estimated at AED 4,200/credit x 24 credits ≈ AED 100,800/yr (program-dependent estimate) -- verify exact graduate schedule before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: High school diploma with minimum GPA, SAT optional, IELTS 5.5-6.0/TOEFL 65-79 depending on program
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree with minimum 2.75/4.0 GPA, IELTS 6.0, GMAT for MBA program

name: New York University Abu Dhabi
tuitionNote: Sources conflict sharply: NYUAD's own undergraduate financial aid model awards full-tuition scholarships to essentially all admitted students (effective sticker tuition near $0 after aid), while published 2026-27 NYU system tuition is cited at $68,576/yr (~AED 252,000, converted here at ~0.25 EUR/AED equivalent to USD for estimate). Figure used here ($68,576 nominal sticker price) is NOT what most students actually pay -- verify before publishing; this is highly need-aware and most NYUAD undergrads receive full-need financial aid. NYUAD does not carry its own separate QS World Ranking (reported jointly under NYU global, ranked #55 as a system in QS 2026).
bachelorRequirements: Highly selective: strong high school record, Common Application with NYU-specific essays, SAT/ACT optional, IELTS 7.0+/TOEFL 100+ recommended, holistic review (acceptance rate under 5%)
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree with strong academic record, IELTS 7.0+/TOEFL 100+, GRE/GMAT depending on program, highly competitive

name: University of Sharjah
tuitionNote: Undergraduate tuition reported between AED 31,049/yr and AED 66,000/yr depending on college -- wide range, figure used here (~AED 45,000/yr midpoint) is an estimate, verify before publishing (sharjah.ac.ae official fee schedule 2025-26). Graduate (Master's) tuition cited at AED 3,045/credit; estimated at ~AED 71,000/yr for a 24-credit load.
bachelorRequirements: High school certificate with required average (varies by college), IELTS 5.5-6.0/TOEFL equivalent, program-specific subject requirements
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree with minimum 3.0/4.0 GPA in relevant field, IELTS 6.0, entrance exam for some programs

name: Heriot-Watt University Dubai
tuitionNote: Undergraduate annual fees reported across a wide range (AED 68,686-115,000/yr) depending on program and year of study, per hw.ac.uk/dubai official fee page and third-party aggregators; figure used here (~AED 90,000/yr midpoint) is an estimate -- exact program-specific fee varies significantly, verify before publishing. Master's tuition assumed similar pending program-specific confirmation.
bachelorRequirements: High school certificate/A-levels equivalent with required grades, IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 78, program-specific subject prerequisites (UK-pattern branch campus of Heriot-Watt University, Scotland)
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree (UK 2:2 equivalent or above), IELTS 6.5, relevant work experience for some MBA/management programs

name: American University of Ras Al Khaimah
localName: American University of Ras Al Khaimah
tuitionNote: Undergraduate fees reported between AED 51,130-61,950/semester equivalent figures across sources (aurak.ac.ae and third-party aggregators), with first-year tuition cited at AED 58,600-60,260; figure used here (~AED 60,000/yr) is a midpoint estimate -- exact per-credit-hour rate not confirmed from official source, verify before publishing. Master's tuition figure assumed equal pending confirmation.

masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree with minimum 2.5-3.0/4.0 GPA, IELTS 6.0, GMAT for MBA program

name: Abu Dhabi University
tuitionNote: Undergraduate tuition reported as AED 1,230-2,085 per credit hour depending on program/campus (adu.ac.ae official fee schedule, 2025-26), estimated at ~AED 52,000/yr for a 30-credit load at the midpoint rate -- wide program variation, verify exact program fee before publishing. Postgraduate tuition reported as AED 1,050-4,620/credit; figure used here assumes a similar midpoint, also requires verification. 5% VAT applies on top of tuition.
bachelorRequirements: High school certificate with required average, IELTS 5.5/TOEFL equivalent, EmSAT for some programs
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree with minimum 2.5-3.0/4.0 GPA, IELTS 6.0, GMAT/GRE for select programs

name: Ajman University
tuitionNote: Per-credit-hour fees reported as a very wide range (AED 1,125-3,500/credit for undergraduate, AED 625-4,500/credit for graduate) depending on college, per ajman.ac.ae official fee brochure 2025-26; one aggregator cites an average annual tuition of AED 173,667/yr across all programs, which is the figure converted here -- this average masks large program-to-program variation (e.g., Medicine/Pharmacy far higher than Arts), verify the specific program fee before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: High school certificate with required average, IELTS 5.0-6.0/TOEFL equivalent depending on college, program-specific prerequisites (Medicine/Pharmacy/Dentistry have higher entry requirements)
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree with minimum 2.5-3.0/4.0 GPA, IELTS 6.0, relevant licensing exams for professional programs (e.g., Pharmacy, Law)

tuitionNote: No specific official per-credit-hour or annual tuition figure for University of Dubai could be confirmed from available sources during research.
